name: Sony MDR-1AM2 Hi-Res Audio Wired Over-Ear Headphones (Original Box)
description: Selling my Sony MDR-1AM2 High-Resolution Audio over-ear headphones, kept in their original retail box with all original accessories (1.2m and 3m detachable cables, carry pouch, manuals). These lightweight (~187g) Hi-Res-certified headphones pair a 40mm liquid-crystal polymer driver with an aluminum-alloy housing and an angled 3D-fit structure, delivering clean, detailed highs and natural mids that are perfect for studio listening or casual hi-fi. Exceptionally comfortable for long sessions. Gently used, in like-new cosmetic and working condition, thoroughly vacuumed and wiped clean before listing. Coming from a pet-friendly home (a cat lives here), so please note it has been sanitized. This item does NOT come with an additional storage bag — please bring your own pouch or backpack for local pickup.
